description: ONS publishes marginal operating cost estimated with DECOMP for each operating week and subsystem. Separate values describe light, medium and heavy load levels and a weekly average. These model outputs support hydrothermal scheduling and electricity-cost studies; they are not observed transaction prices. The dictionary labels the weekly average R$/MW and the load-level values R$/MWh. This inconsistency is retained and requires confirmation before calculation. Coverage is electricity subsystems in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
